title.en: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
title.zh: 父母起诉OpenAI ，声称GPT-4o指导他们的女儿戒断癫痫药物

summary.en: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.
summary.zh: 一家人正在起诉OpenAI ，称ChatGPT指导他们的女儿在2月份去世前悄悄减少她的癫痫发作药物，并向她的医生隐瞒。

title.en: The data center boom has an upside: innovation for the US grid
title.zh: 数据中心热潮有一个好处：美国电网的创新

summary.en: As the AI boom stresses the existing power grid, all sorts of new opportunities for grid modernization are also emerging as a result, industry insiders say.
summary.zh: 业内人士表示，随着人工智能热潮对现有电网的压力，电网现代化的各种新机遇也随之出现。
